name: happ
title: Happ
description: Control the Happ VPN client: toggle the tunnel, switch servers, read connection state.
author: cosmdandy

commands.name: toggle-vpn
commands.title: Toggle VPN
commands.subtitle: Happ
commands.description: Connect or disconnect the tunnel, whichever is the opposite of the current state.

commands.name: select-server
commands.title: Select Server
commands.subtitle: Happ
commands.description: Pick a server from the subscription and connect to it.

commands.name: vpn-status
commands.title: VPN Status
commands.subtitle: Happ
commands.description: Current server, uptime and connection counters in the menu bar.

commands.name: copy-proxy-url
commands.title: Copy Proxy URL
commands.subtitle: Happ
commands.description: Copy the local HTTP or SOCKS proxy address exposed by Happ.

commands.name: open-log
commands.title: Open Log
commands.subtitle: Happ
commands.description: Open the current Xray log file.

commands.name: refresh-subscription
commands.title: Refresh Subscription
commands.subtitle: Happ
commands.description: Ask Happ to refresh its subscription and widget.

commands.name: rebuild-server-map
commands.title: Rebuild Server Map
commands.subtitle: Happ
commands.description: Learn which config UUID belongs to which server name. Switches through every config once.

preferences.name: shortcutToggle
preferences.title: Toggle Shortcut
preferences.description: Name of the Shortcuts shortcut wrapping Happ's Toggle TUNNEL action.

preferences.name: shortcutConnect
preferences.description: Name of the shortcut wrapping Connect TUNNEL.
preferences.title: Connect Shortcut

preferences.name: shortcutDisconnect
preferences.description: Name of the shortcut wrapping Disconnect TUNNEL.
preferences.title: Disconnect Shortcut

preferences.name: shortcutSelect
preferences.description: Name of the shortcut wrapping Select Server. It must accept the config ID as its input.
preferences.title: Select Server Shortcut

preferences.name: shortcutRefresh
preferences.description: Name of the shortcut wrapping Refresh widget.
preferences.title: Refresh Shortcut

preferences.name: shortcutPing
preferences.title: Ping Shortcut
preferences.description: Name of the shortcut wrapping Happ's Ping action (CheckCurrentConnection). Only the active connection can be measured.
